calibration.reuse_limitation: Same small calibration set fits temperature and selects threshold; calibration metrics are optimistic
calibration.rule: maximize accepted calibration count with >=3 accepted and empirical joint error <=0.10; ties choose higher threshold

data_binding.immutable: Content-addressed and write-once; existing mismatches fail closed

training.features: L2-normalized word unigram/bigram and character trigram counts
training.loss: sum of four independent multiclass cross-entropies
training.regularization: sparse active-coordinate L2=0.0002; not dense global L2
